description: Project Ultimate agent registry entry (frozen, design v1.0 §6). Registry keys are the sim's lowercase ids (needle … kingcode) — the spawn gate compares these exact strings, so the backend uses them verbatim. The LIVE client renders exactly the registry: no more, no fewer.

capabilities.description: Work verbs the agent may perform: the home island's verbs from world/islands.json (e.g. needle -> SCOUT, VERIFY, SIGN).

department.description: CWI department, or 'Chief of Staff' for the chief.

home_island.description: Island where the entity rests when offline or idle. One of the 14 islands in world/islands.json.

id.description: Stable registry key; equals the sim entity id and the agents/<id>.json filename stem. Immutable.

kind.description: department = one of the 8 CWI departments; chief = KingCode; guest reserved for future guest admission via the spawn gate.

moltbook.description: Registration record per the known Moltbook state (2026-09-15).

profile.description: Presentation refs. Creative copy lives in persona_line; it is presentation, not a factual claim.

seed.description: true while this entry comes from the Phase-0 seed (not yet verified live).

status.description: Registry status. Quarantined agents keep an honest presence (dimmed, flagged) — never silently dropped.
